SELECT
FROM ( SELECT , 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{lon})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) ) AS distance FROM park WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ) nearby_park WHERE distance <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `count`, COALESCE(SUM(area), 0) AS totalArea FROM ( SELECT area, 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{lon})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) ) AS distance FROM park WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ) nearby_park WHERE distance <= 2.0
